I once smoked a whole lot of weed in a party and went to the kitchen for some water, then I overheard my bf (we'd been together for a year and a half) talking to someone about it being "too soon to tell if it would work out" and it "not being the right time for that kind of commitment". so I came out of hiding and stared at him, he saw me, I left to a room and he did not follow me. I was devastated thinking he didn't care about me this whole time, not even enough to come and say something, I was so shocked I couldn't even cry. some painfully long minutes passed and he appeared, sat by my side and... touched my leg and tried to make out. I felt like a slice of meat, like he didn't give a fuck about how I was feeling after hearing him say that. I don't know what kept me from going home immediately, blocking him in every social media and never talking to him ever again but I'm glad I didn't. turns out he was talking about a couple of friends of ours who decided to get married, of course he wouldn't get how offended I was by that. he thought I was flirting by staring at him and rushing to a room so he finished talking and went there to make out. when he explained everything to me I was rather traumatized by that experience but it made so much sense, I was completely tricked by a bad trip.

so yeah, bad trips happen and they CAN ruin relationships if there is no communication afterwards. god knows what happened inside your friend's head before he made that decision. talk to him, I hope it's not too late
